summary: SMOTE oversampling increased the minority-class F1 score by 0.005530, which is less than the 0.02 threshold. F1 score without SMOTE: 0.669254, with SMOTE: 0.674785.
primary_metric_name: F1 score difference (SMOTE - No Resampling) for minority class (>50K)
methodological_choices: Random Forest with default hyperparameters (RandomForestClassifier()). Preprocessing: dropped rows with missing values, label-encoded categorical features. Train-test split: 70-30 with stratification (random_state=42). SMOTE applied only to training set. Evaluation metric: F1 score for minority class (>50K, class=1) on held-out test set. SMOTE configuration: default parameters (random_state=42). Comparison: absolute difference in F1 scores between models with and without SMOTE.
